statement.name: LockUserAccount
statement.sql:
UPDATE AC_User SET LoginFailedCount = ISNULL(LoginFailedCount, 0) + 1, LastLoginFailedDateTime = GETDATE(), LockoutDateTime= GETDATE() WHERE UserId =
execute uspAC_LogUserAction @UserId,@UserId,10,'Locked By System'

statement.name: UnlockUserAccount
statement.sql:
UPDATE AC_User SET LockoutDateTime = NULL, LoginFailedCount = NULL, LastLoginFailedDateTime = NULL WHERE UserId =
set @strUnlockActionComment = 'Account Unlocked By System on login after ' + cast(@AccountLockoutEffectiveMins as varchar(10)) + ' minutes of account lockout' execute uspAC_LogUserAction @UserId, @UserId, 11, @strUnlockActionComment

statement.name: GetQuickLinkReports
statement.sql: SELECT uf.ReportId AS Id, catalog.Name, catalog.Path FROM ERS_UserFavorites uf, ERS_Report catalog WHERE UserID = AND uf.ReportId = catalog.ReportId AND QuickLinksFlag = 1 ORDER BY catalog.Name

statement.name: GetRecentlyVisitedReports
statement.sql: SELECT TOP 5 rh.ReportId as Id, catalog.Name, catalog.Path FROM ERS_ReportsVisitedHistory rh, ERS_Report catalog WHERE rh.UserId = AND rh.ReportID = catalog.ReportId GROUP BY rh.ReportId, catalog.Name, catalog.path, catalog.ExecutionSystemID ORDER BY 3 DESC
